reason: Reproduced on home.books-toggle and billpay.books-signup: Cash is the selected Accounting basis segment and has tabindex=-1, so Tab skips it. Accrual is tabbable, Enter on it selects Accrual and makes Cash tabbable, then Shift+Tab reaches Cash and Enter selects it again. Both bases are keyboard-operable and Space on the selected Cash changed nothing.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 Keyboard needs every function to work from the keyboard. The skipped Cash button is the segment already selected and activating it is a no-op. Choosing Cash after Accrual is possible by keyboard (focus Accrual, Enter, Shift+Tab to Cash, Enter), and the buttons are type=button so nothing submits. 2.4.3 holds because the order stays logical. Whether the selected segment exposes its state to assistive tech falls under 4.1.2, a different claim from this finding and not tested here. No A or AA criterion fails on keyboard reach.
